title: Pin to Dock Pins to a Hidden Dock

steps: Pin the exact same provider/command to Start page and Dock; compare persisted provider/command IDs, materialized item and pin/unpin menu state.
Repeat with one visible dock, hidden primary/two monitors, and two enabled docks; record the actual selected monitor ID.
Reload the provider and restart CmdPal without resetting settings; test top-level resolution and ICommandProvider4 lookup for stored IDs.
Compare51760 publication controls and51762 Apps alias controls separately; include a genuinely unsupported nested extension command as a negative control.
prerequisites: Preserve existing diagnostics/settings; use disposable CmdPal settings for controlled pinning. Include a stable built-in PowerToys command, cmd and a documented extension band.
reproduce.expected_result: A supported persisted command resolves after publication/reload and has consistent visible/menu state. Hidden-monitor routing and deliberately unsupported extension commands remain distinct, with candidate coverage measured rather than assumed.
reproduce.version_requirement: Current build and existing51760/51762 candidates; original report0.100.2 is historical
